title: GoHighLevel setup and deployment
meta_title: GoHighLevel setup and deployment | Artificia AI
meta_description: We set up and run GoHighLevel for businesses: pipelines, WhatsApp and email follow-ups, lead routing and AI calls. See how we run it for Orkay Tiles.

fields.subheading: We set up GoHighLevel around how you sell: pipelines, WhatsApp and email follow-ups, lead routing and reports. Then we keep it running.

fields.heading: What we *set up*
fields.body:
GoHighLevel is a CRM with pipelines, WhatsApp, email, forms, calendars and automations in one place.

We set it up around how your team sells, connect your ads and website, and run it with you after launch.

Orkay Tiles runs two accounts this way. Read the Orkay case study.

items.title: New leads
items.before: Ad leads sit in a spreadsheet until someone notices them.
items.after: Each lead lands in a pipeline with its source and an owner.

items.title: Follow-up
items.before: Leads go cold when a rep forgets to call back.
items.after: Unanswered leads get an automatic follow-up.

items.title: Reporting
items.before: Managers ask each rep what happened yesterday.
items.after: A daily report shows what came in and what moved.

steps.title: Map how you sell
steps.text: We map your lead sources, stages, team, and the messages each lead should get.

steps.title: Build the account
steps.text: Pipelines, fields, tags, forms, calendars and workflows, set up and tested.

steps.title: Connect your sources
steps.text: Meta ads, website forms and WhatsApp feed straight into the account.

steps.title: Run and improve
steps.text: We watch the account, fix what breaks and add workflows as you grow.

fields.heading: Two GoHighLevel accounts for *Orkay Tiles*
fields.summary: We set up and run Orkay's two GoHighLevel accounts: one for dealers in India, one for export buyers.

built.title: India dealer account
built.text: Dealer and distributor leads, handled WhatsApp-first in Hindi and regional languages.

built.title: International export account
built.text: Importers and distributors abroad, worked by email.

built.title: Routed by language
built.text: Regional-language leads go to the rep who speaks that language.

built.title: Reported back to Meta
built.text: New Facebook and Instagram leads in the India account go to Meta as lead events, so the ads learn which clicks became leads.

items.question: Do I need a GoHighLevel account already?
items.answer: No. We can set up a new account, or take over and tidy one you already have.

items.question: Can GoHighLevel handle WhatsApp leads?
items.answer: Yes. Orkay's India account runs WhatsApp-first: leads arrive, get an owner and receive follow-ups inside GoHighLevel.

items.question: Can it call leads automatically?
items.answer: Yes. For Orkay we connected an AI voice agent that calls new India leads in Hindi.

items.question: Do you run the account after setup?
items.answer: Yes. We run Orkay's accounts day to day: fixing problems, adding workflows and checking the daily report.

cards.title: Website development

cards.title: Content and marketing

cards.title: RAG and custom automation
cards.text: Assistants that answer leads from your own documents.
